title: Graduate civil engineer or civil draftsperson - expression of interest (Melbourne)
content_text:
Careers at Taylors Development Strategists
Relationships, Expertise and Solutions across Urban Development, Built Environments, Infrastructure and Engineering and Project Management.
65 years experience, 160+ professionals.
Services include Civil Engineering, Land Surveying, Urban Planning, Urban Design, Architecture, Landscape Architecture, Project Management, Engineering Construction Survey, Engineering Design Survey, Utilities Asset Capture and Geospatial Mapping.
Careers page contact for business updates and enquiries: enquiries@taylorsds.com.au, phone 03 9501 2800.
No individual dated vacancy listed on the careers page on 3 Oct 2026.
Target roles of interest: graduate civil engineer, junior civil designer or civil draftsperson supporting land development and infrastructure work in Melbourne.
apply_instructions: Email enquiries@taylorsds.com.au with resume and short note on the work sought (careers page publishes this inbox). Label as speculative EOI; no dated vacancy verified today.
